SMTO-BOOT-0013 — Your model engine version lacks a feature this script needs

GUID: 9ab125de-d0b3-4467-91c6-89458786a048
Slug: boot-model-feature-unsupported
Domain: BOOT · Subsystem: boot

What happened

  • Before loading the model, the start script checked the engine program's list of options, and an option it needs (for example --spec-type) was missing. It stopped before loading the model.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Note the option named in the terminal message, such as --spec-type or --split-mode. That's the feature your current engine version doesn't offer.
  2. Update llama.cpp to a newer version and rebuild llama-server (src/llama/setup.sh shows how it's built), then run the start script again. Newer versions add the options these start scripts rely on, and changing the model files can't add them.
  3. If you have more than one copy of llama-server, point the script at the newer one with SERVER_BIN, or LLAMA_SERVER_BIN for the Qwen3.8 Flash script. The script checks whichever copy it's told to use, which may be an older one.

What success looks like

  • The script gets past the feature check and the engine starts loading the model.

If it still fails

  • Copy the full terminal output and the engine's version, and send them to the person who maintains the model setup after removing private folder names. Don't remove the option from the script to force it to start.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The model launcher's preflight scan of the selected server binary's --help output did not find a flag required by this launch profile (for example --spec-type, --split-mode, --override-tensor, --fit, --cache-ram, --no-mmproj or --chat-template-kwargs) and exited before loading weights.

What this means

  • Launcher inspection of the server's help output cannot find a flag required by this launch profile. The launcher reads the selected server's help output and stops before loading weights when a required flag is absent. A failed help check does not establish support for the model architecture, available GPU memory or successful inference.

Why this can happen

  • Launcher inspection of the server's help output cannot find a flag required by this launch profile.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the exact executable's --help with the required flag and supported launch profile.

How to fix it

  • Run the selected binary with --help and search for the flag named in the technical detail; upgrade or rebuild llama.cpp to a build that provides every flag the profile uses, or point SERVER_BIN or LLAMA_SERVER_BIN at such a build, then rerun the preflight. A passing help check does not prove model-architecture support, sufficient GPU memory or successful inference.
  • Update to a supported build for this model and launcher, then inspect --help for the required flag.

Retry and execution caution

  • Use a server build advertising every flag required by this launcher, then repeat the preflight.

How to verify the fix

  • A matching supported server build advertises the required feature.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • The launcher reads the selected server's help output and stops before loading weights when a required flag is absent.
  • A failed help check does not establish support for the model architecture, available GPU memory or successful inference.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
